story.s2.card2.title: Umbrellas discarded per week in one Seoul district
story.s3.line1: UPbrella stands for The Better Choice,
story.s3.line3: By choosing UPbrella instead of buying one disposable umbrella,
story.s3.line4: we can save the 100 years it takes for one to decompose.
story.s3.line5: On rainy days, small actions anyone can take come together
story.s3.line6: to make the world a better place.
story.s4.line1: Through shared umbrellas as a medium,
story.s4.line4: We raise awareness of partner locations near Sinchon and Hanyang University,
story.s4.line5: create synergy between UPbrella and our partners,
story.s4.line6: and aim to revitalize the local business community.
story.s5.label: UPbrella Team
story.s5.title: Meet the UPbrella Team!
story.s5.desc: Our team came together to build a more sustainable and convenient platform.
story.s6.team1.name: Service Development Team
story.s6.team1.desc: The Service Development Team researches user experience and analyzes rental/return data to establish optimal policies, striving to enhance user satisfaction.
story.s6.team2.name: External Partnerships Team
story.s6.team2.desc: The External Partnerships Team partners with Sinchon businesses to distribute shared umbrellas and raises awareness through marketing. We also explore new opportunities to expand the service.
story.s7.title: Our Journey
story.s7.desc1: UPbrella is a team of Yonsei University undergraduates,
story.s7.desc2: launched as a Sinchon-based umbrella-sharing platform on April 12, 2021.

info.faq.q1: Do I have to return the umbrella to the same location?
info.faq.a1: No! You can return it at any partner location nearest to you.
info.faq.q2: How can I check business hours?
info.faq.a2: On-campus locations at Yonsei University are available 24/7. For off-campus locations (cafés), please visit during their business hours. You can check each location's hours on the 'Rental Locations' page.
info.faq.q3: When will I get my deposit refund?
info.faq.a3: It typically takes 2–3 days. During sudden rainstorms, higher volume may cause slight delays. We're working to make UPbrella even more convenient while protecting both your wallet and the environment. For urgent inquiries, please contact UPbrella on Kakao Plus Friend (search 'upbrella' in Kakao).
